# deploy to aws

- https://github.com/mitchellh/vagrant-aws
- https://github.com/hashicorp/vagrant
- https://github.com/ansible/ansible

```bash
$ vagrant plugin install vagrant-aws
$ vagrant up --provider=aws
```
